title: Verify recipe recovery across a normal restart
changes: Verify the explicit guest-only recipe recovery path across a normal close and reopen of the same isolated session.
validation: A status step completed and a simulated cancellation stopped the following step; after reopening under a different control-run identity, recovery preserved the completed result and request identity, sent no guest action, and resumed exactly one frame.
A second resume preserved state, frame, clock and keys. Both windows closed normally; ROM, seed state and runtime inputs remained unchanged.
limitations: One guest-only recipe, simulated cancellation and silent audio; no runtime crash, pending-action replay, waits, host-dependent recovery, Windows or physical input was tested.
